harper: Heads-up PR #1482 changed the POST /v1/rerank request example to include `queries: ["q1"]` at top-level, but our OpenAPI schema nests queries under `input`: { input: { queries: [...] } }. This will fail the example linter. cc @sophie @ben

sophie: Link?

harper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1482 - the author mirrored a quick cURL from an internal test; backend accepts both shapes for compatibility, but our canonical docs should match the schema.

docs-bot: openapi-lint: example/type-mismatch: /paths/~1v1~1rerank/post/requestBody/content/application~1json/schema expected property `input` but found `queries` in example.

ben: Agreed we should keep the canonical shape. Proposed fix: revert the example to use `input.queries` and add a small "legacy top-level queries" sub-example showing the alternate shape. Add a short SDK snippet showing a normalization helper in Python and TS.

sophie: For snippets keep minimal: TS `function normalize(body:any){ if(Array.isArray(body.queries)) return {input:{queries:body.queries}}; return body; }` Python `def normalize(body): return {'input': {'queries': body['queries']}} if 'queries' in body else body` — with brief comment about defensive parsing.

harper: I'll update the PR to restore canonical example, append the legacy example block, and include the two snippets plus a tiny fixture under examples/fixtures/rerank-both.json for CI. Also adding a line to the docs changelog: "Docs: clarify rerank request shape and add migration snippets for legacy top-level queries."

docs-bot: ci/checks: openapi-lint failing until example matches schema.

ben: Also add a one-line note in the SDK migration guide recommending `normalize` be run before validation. Keeps SDKs robust.

harper: Good call. Pushing commit now and will ping for review.

sophie: Reviewing. Quick nit: in the TS helper include `Array.isArray` guard and coerce values to strings if needed.

harper: Updated snippets per feedback, added fixture, and wired examples-validate in CI. Pushed.

docs-bot: ci/checks: examples-validate passed. openapi-lint passed.

ben: LGTM. Merging after docs approval.

harper: Merged. Closing thread. :tada:
